Emberfall v5 asset credits

All models are the exact models linked by the user. Original geometry, topology, normals, materials and colors retained. No external textures. Static geometry, no skeletons or animation. Normalization changes root transforms only, preserving originals under Poly Pizza IDs.

Runtime changes: body armor fitted to Chest; helmet rotated to face forward and fitted to the selected character’s Head. Transparent glass disables depth writing. Staff rarity variants can add emissive color. Models otherwise retain the supplied geometry.

Audio: original 112 BPM, 34.29-second synthesized minor string, bass and hand-drum loop. No samples or third-party composition. Source: scripts/render-music.py.
